name: Discovery
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.requirement: Use actual source space, plane, vicinity, senses and observer. Retain hidden-object, trap, Medicine, Insight, tracks and Study declarations independently; automatic language recognition is distinct from rolling to notice. Reveal only the declared result to eligible observers and persist receipts without another roll or cost.

blockers: OA-01–OA-13 room controls are reusable bounded hosts. Generated event checks have no positioned trap or automatic general Search/disarm implementation. Do not convert flavor text into hidden-object/track/knowledge facts.
reuse_boundary: Existing accepted pieces remain accepted at their documented limits; these requirements do not mark the entire slices missing.
